sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.

The present petition has been filed under Section 528 BNSS on behalf of the petitioners seeking quashing of case FIR No. 700/2020 dated 02.11.2020 and charge-sheet under Sections 344/376/363 IPC and Section 6 POCSO Act and the proceedings emanating therefrom.
Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State has accepted the notice and seeks time to file the status report.
Let the status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The complainant has appeared in person and requests that a legal aid counsel be provided to her.
Secretary, Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee is directed to provide a legal aid counsel to the complainant.
